name: image-streetwear-collage
title: Streetwear Collage
description: Four-up collage of street looks shot on the same set

subject.descent: Not asserted — synthetic subject; specify explicitly when recreating.
subject.physical: Four separate frames of the same figure — standing, turning, adjusting sunglasses; consistent build and hair throughout
subject.clothing: White cropped top, high-waisted shorts or skirt, dark sunglasses

composition.shotType: Four-panel collage of full and half-figure frames

framing.subjectScale: Four equal panels, each subject filling ~55% of its own cell width
framing.subjectBox: Two-by-two grid; cell boundaries at 50% on both axes; figure centred in each cell
framing.anchors: Each cell carries its own eyeline at roughly 25–30% of cell height
framing.edges: Figures crop at cell edges; no bleed across panel gutters
framing.negativeSpace: Thin gutter between panels; no outer margin

environment.background: Domestic and hallway detail visible but secondary
environment.depth: Subject plus readable background per panel

lighting.direction: Window and overhead ambient, no controlled key

camera.quality: Snapshot sharpness, light noise in shadows

atmosphere.story: A single outfit photographed four ways.
